description: The reference's V8 preset: a 6.2 L crossplane V8, naturally aspirated, gasoline. Its targets are those of a passenger-car V8 of that size; the fast ones (ctest's) are the contract's and the limiter's.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: Holds the limiter
targets.source: a fuel-cut rev limiter holds the speed within a few percent of where it cuts (some 100 to 200 rpm at 6500)

targets.name: Warm idle
targets.source: a warm passenger-car V8 idles at 600 to 900 rpm in neutral (a rule of thumb from makers' service specifications)

targets.name: Peak torque
targets.source: a naturally aspirated spark-ignition engine's brake mean effective pressure at its torque peak is 1.0 to 1.4 MPa (Heywood, Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, ch. 2); T = bmep Vd / 4 pi for 6.2 L

targets.name: Peak power
targets.source: a naturally aspirated road engine makes 40 to 75 kW a litre (a rule of thumb), 248 to 465 kW for 6.2 L

targets.name: Port gas at full load
targets.source: a spark-ignition engine's exhaust gas at the port at full load is some 900 to 1100 K (Heywood, ch. 14; makers' exhaust-gas-temperature data for petrol engines): the integrator measured 1100 to 1330 K, a miss on the hot side, reported
